title: Solo UserContext (WP4)
description: Versioned context block assembled by lib/context_assembler.ts and consumed by P8 (guidance) and P9 (Ask Solo). HARD INVARIANT: total assembled context <= 8000 tokens for any user at any subscription month. Section budgets sum to 7500 (< 8000) and each section is clipped/packed to its own budget, so the cap holds structurally; a belt-and-suspenders compression pass enforces it if estimates drift. Design: admin/wp4-context-assembly-design-2026-05-31.md.

recent_checkins.x_source: checkin_history (last N by day_number; narrative_addition / exchanges)

topic_relevant_history.x_source: pgvector top-5 over context_embeddings via match_context_embeddings RPC (Ask Solo only, keyed on the question)

x_observability: lib/context_assembler.ts writes an events row (event_type='context_assembled', payload={total_tokens, within_cap, sections:[{section,tokens,budget,compressed}]}) on every assembly.
